notes: 0.8.0 adds a smoother workout experience, clearer Settings and improved rest-timer controls.
Focus includes a swipeable exercise carousel, compact navigation and a shared header rest timer. Completed sets use a continuous highlight.
Settings groups your everyday controls on one page with an expandable training profile.
The exercise bar keeps its glass frame steady while you scroll. A thin progress line tracks completed required working sets.
Training Block date and duration fields fit phones. Automatic rest stops when required workout work is finished.
Optional countdown and completion sounds, vibration and Keep Screen Awake follow your workout preferences and browser capabilities.
Your saved records, photos and active workout remain on your device. Production and preview journals stay separate.
